links.outcome: Multi-agent final answers substituting authority or majority for evidence checking
links.effect: Authority bias in 28.76% of cases (rising from 35.30% to 68.75% across rounds), self-contradiction 18.53%, contradiction neglect 5.48%, minority suppression 5.11%.
links.quote: During synthesis, final answers often substitute authority or majority count for evidence checking, showing authority bias in 28.76% (rising from 35.30% to 68.75% across rounds), self-contradiction in 18.53%, contradiction neglect in 5.48% and minority suppression in 5.11%.

unlisted_practices: Process-level workflow auditing of multi-agent AI collaboration, including discussion and consensus failure modes

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated audit framework (MedAgentAudit) to evaluate process-level safety, failure modes, and false consensus in medical multi-agent LLM systems across benchmark datasets.

primary.practice: process-level safety auditing of multi-agent collaboration
